gates.evidence: Build contract is valid or explicitly not applicable.
Gate registry is valid and required gates are declared.
Pre-build estimate exists, validates, and matches runtime budgets.
Run-date stack choices are checked against current official/source material with evidence.
Runtime state is valid or explicitly not applicable.
Phase order and prior-stage evidence are valid before advancement.
Referenced evidence exists and supports the gate or stage verdict it is used for.
Accepted risks and high-risk ship decisions have approved owner signoff with evidence.
All real forks are closed in debate/OPEN.json and any ADR records include decision, rationale, rejected alternatives, dissent, owner, and index evidence.
The raw user request is refined into an enterprise build brief with outcome, scope, acceptance criteria, routing, specialists, verification, and stop conditions.
The raw goal is upgraded into a concrete enterprise blueprint with users, jobs, artifacts, surfaces, acceptance proof, trust, operations, cuts, and final delivery packet.
Agent roster, SDLC stage gates, role independence, frontend/backend coverage, handoffs, worktree boundaries, and audit trail are planned and checkable.
AI tools, models, agents, MCP/plugin surfaces, data boundaries, approvals, output gates, cost controls, audit logs, and rollback controls are inventoried and approved before ship.

Authorization and tenant-isolation surfaces prove deny-by-default decisions, role/permission coverage, negative access tests, anonymous denial, privilege-escalation prevention, audit logging, and signed local evidence before ship.

Personal, sensitive, regulated, or AI-context data surfaces prove inventory, purpose, minimization, lawful basis, retention, deletion/export paths, redacted logging, encryption, transfers, breach response, DPIA handling, tests, and signed local evidence before ship.

Code-producing and deployable work proves local build, shared dev, staging, beta, production, independent review, QA, adversarial checks, rollback, monitoring, signoff, and retro evidence actually ran before ship.
Project-specific AGENTS/CLAUDE/rules context, context budget, baton, and subagent handoff refs are present and checkable.
Upstream source-router receipts prove source id, immutable pinned ref, extracted pattern, rejected parts, safety checks, artifact refs, verification, and rollback where needed.
Loop workspace files, work-log grammar, signal/doc schemas, and domain-loop schema are present and checkable.
The run mines traces, scouts current GitHub sources, proposes bounded improvements, validates regressions, and captures compounding lessons.
An independent evaluator scores the delivered artifact against the requested outcome with rubric evidence, confidence, bias checks, and no blockers.
QA report proves unit/integration, functional, logic, integration, data integrity, security, and UX/resilience checks with fresh evidence.
Documented shell blocks parse cleanly or are intentionally skipped.

Brownfield upgrade (§2.6): the existing app's intent is reverse-engineered into a non-stub INTENT.md (what-it-is, original goal, used-for, confirmed/inferred/unknown claims with file:line evidence) — or already documented in a non-stub PRD.md. Greenfield => not applicable.

Brownfield upgrade (§2.6): a before-snapshot (build/tests/8-dim/security/perf) plus a characterization/golden-master net is captured in baseline.json BEFORE the first upgrade edit, so improvement and non-regression are provable. Greenfield => not applicable.

Brownfield upgrade (§2.6): the upgraded app is proven >= the captured baseline on EVERY dimension (no silent regression), the golden-master net is green, and every behavior change carries a signed ADR. Greenfield => not applicable.

L4 data-flow: every data-backed handler is fed by a REAL source (db/query/fetch), not a static []/{} or mock stub. From gsd-build/get-shit-done verifier L4.
Every SKILL.md is routable: has name + a trigger-bearing description, not bloated/stub. Composite >= floor, zero broken. From addyosmani/agent-skills + ECC plugin-eval.
Generated analytics/SQL is free of join-explosion, average-of-averages, nested-aggregate, and unguarded-denominator pitfalls. From ECC data/validate-data.
Working context auto-compacts at ABSOLUTE thresholds (compact 150k / handoff 200k) per compaction-policy.json; inherited context stays under the ceiling, hands-free. Tony standing rule.
Every senior persona REQUIRED by the build signals engaged (Chief of Staff + Senior PM + specialists + Audit Squad) — breadcrumbed, not skipped. From personas.json (Tony org model).
UI meets Apple-grade craft floors: tight type scale · 4/8pt spacing grid · semantic tokens · snappy motion · declared design system. Tony standing bar: build it like Apple built it.
A passing-tests claim is REPRODUCED: the recorded test command is re-run and must exit 0. Evidence over assertion. From 0xNyk/lacp.
Meta-harness: every registry gate selftest is green — a careless edit cannot silently flip a gate open. From dotclaude hooks/tests + WALTEUR gauntlet.
Every required tool actually EXECS (not just command -v): missing|BROKEN-shim|timeout|ok. Catches dead pipx/npm/winget shims. From Panniantong/Agent-Reach.
Every SKILL.md satisfies the upload contract: kebab name <=64, description present <=1024 no <>, known keys. From anthropics/skills skill-creator.

Governed external data sourcing: every web/file acquisition routes through a VETTED tool (data-tools.json), records provenance (url/tool/output_ref), proves robots+PII handling, and high-risk anti-bot/auth-bypass tools (curl_cffi/browser-use/crawlee) require a recorded legal_signoff. From the Firecrawl/Crawl4AI/browser-use/MarkItDown/curl_cffi data-tools intake.

The immutable certification ledger STAMP.md is never deleted and no history row removed/altered: each row sha256 in stamp-chain.json is re-hashed, fail-closed on divergence; the Current score block stays re-stampable. Score-of-record survives file optimization.

EXECUTING gate: runs Knip (webpro-nl/knip, ISC) on a JS/TS project and OBSERVES its REAL exit (0 clean / 1 unused files+exports+deps / 2 tool error); fail-closed on findings>WALTEUR_KNIP_MAX or tool error. Knip absent => loud SKIP (acquire via tool-acquisition; couldnt-measure != pass). From audit-tools.json intake.

EXECUTING gate: runs orm-doctor (NoctisNova, MIT) on a Prisma/Drizzle project and OBSERVES its real score(0-100)+exit; FAIL on critical exit or score<WALTEUR_ORMSCORE_MIN (N+1/missing-index/unsafe-SQL/table-wipe/unbounded). AST-grade layer above regex data-correctness-gate. orm-doctor absent=loud SKIP. From audit-tools.json.

EXECUTING gate: runs MEDUSA (Pantheon-Security, AGPL — external CLI only, never vendored) and OBSERVES real findings/exit (40k+ patterns: CVEs/secrets/prompt-injection/MCP-poisoning); fail-closed on findings>WALTEUR_MEDUSA_MAX or scanner error. medusa absent=loud SKIP. From audit-tools.json.

META robustness gate (S008 fix): measures on a REAL run how many applicable gates EXECUTED+observed (re-ran a command / ran a tool / observed an exit) vs merely shape-read a self-written JSON; loud-reports the ratio so an all-green box where nothing actually ran cannot pass silently; FAILs below WALTEUR_EXECRATIO_MIN floor.

A resilience surface (high/regulated risk or a declared SLO/availability target) proves an ACTIVE chaos/game-day drill ran: a fresh chaos-report.json with at least one recovered drill whose evidence_ref resolves, and no un-accepted failed drill. Complements static resilience-lint — config that was never drilled is a hope, not a proof.

A deployable that declares secrets/env (secrets-policy.json) proves no secret VALUES are committed (active scan with an execution marker), every declared secret is sourced from a managed store (kms/vault/secret-manager/env-injected) and rotated within rotation_max_age_days, and the static secret scan ran recently.

A declared deploy/cutover proves a zero-downtime strategy (blue-green/canary/expand-contract/rolling) with a present rollback_command, a fresh rollback_proof whose exit_code==0, reversible migrations (or signed expand-contract justification), and a health_check. Under WALTEUR_CUTOVER_EXEC=1 the rollback_proof command is RE-RUN through the allowlisted-runner+token guard and the exit observed.

A service/deployable proves slo.json declares at least one errors SLO and one latency SLO, every SLO is bound to a non-dangling alert, each error_budget is a number 0<eb<=100, every dashboard ref resolves to a non-empty in-tree file, and logging.structured==true. The operate-readiness companion to otel instrumentation.

DECIDABLE static guard (vendored-concept from loopkit flaky-hunter, MIT): catches tests that MASK flakiness with retryTimes(/this.retries(/.retry(/retries:N instead of fixing the race. warning-first by default (exit 0 + loud WARN); arm blocking with WALTEUR_FLAKY=hard. No test files => loud SKIP (recorded). selftest 10/10 (3 retry-mask poisons caught + negative control + PAUSED).

META robustness gate: freshness+coherence floor across every walteur-kit/*-report.json carrying a .verdict -- ts must exist and be within WALTEUR_REPORT_MAXAGE hours (default 72, fresh mode) -- verdict PASS with a nonzero .observed_exit is a self-contradiction (finding) -- any *_executed:true marker without a co-recorded .observed_exit on the same report is a finding. Advisory by default (exit 0, findings reported); WALTEUR_REPORT_INTEGRITY=hard makes any finding block (exit 2). Bypass: WALTEUR_REPORT_INTEGRITY_GATE=off.

Kills passes-by-being-empty: arms when build-contract.json.data_needs==true OR preflight-signals.json.needs_external_data==true. Neither present/true => NOT_APPLICABLE exit 0 (mirrors data-acquisition-gate's arming convention). Armed and walteur-kit/acquisition-log.jsonl is absent/empty/every artifact under 64 bytes on disk, or stale beyond WALTEUR_DATAPULL_WINDOW_H hours (default 24) => FAIL exit 2. PASS when at least 1 fresh, well-formed, real (>=64B on-disk) acquisition breadcrumb {ts,source,query_or_url,artifact,bytes} exists. Closes the case data-acquisition-gate cannot catch because it only arms when a data-acquisition.json manifest already exists. Bypass: WALTEUR_DATAPULL=off.

External ledger rows in field-runs/SHIPPED.md claiming a public npm package or GitHub repo are machine-verified (npm view / gh api) before being counted verified; a verified claim with no working check is a FAIL. Bypass: WALTEUR_FIELDSHIP=off.

Every registered gate id has a matching `## ` heading, named after the gate id, as a fix-recipe anchor in REMEDIATION.md, and every hook under walteur-kit/hooks/ honors the documented --help self-documentation contract.

TEAM MODE runs (5-7 named Claude Code terminals on the peerbus) leave coherent, non-forged receipts: no phantom peers vs team-manifest.json, independent heartbeats, done-only-after-claim with claim timestamp no later than done timestamp, no builder self-done (review mandatory), well-formed message envelopes. No _team/ bus => NOT_APPLICABLE. Bus without manifest => FAIL (fail-closed). Bypass: WALTEUR_TEAM_GATE=off (recorded).
lessons.jsonl capture pipeline is live (append-only --capture helper) and its freshness is checked; a missing or stale store is WARNed, never build-blocking.

Untrusted-input projects run an EXECUTED adversarial corpus (DoS, prototype-pollution, path-traversal, canary-exfil) against the real target and prove it survives: bounded termination, no signal-crash, no secret/traversal leak.

UI projects declaring walteur-kit/contrast-pairs.json have every text/bg pair COMPUTED against the WCAG 2.1 AA contrast floor (4.5:1 normal, 3.0:1 large) via real relative-luminance math - not regex hex-counting.

UI projects declaring walteur-kit/design-scale.json have their type ramp COMPUTED for strict monotonicity, every spacing token checked against the author-declared base grid, and every tap target verified >= 44px (WCAG 2.5.5 / HIG) - real token arithmetic, opt-in, sibling to design-contrast-gate.

A FRESH adversarial cross-model (Codex) verdict receipt ending VERDICT: SHIP exists for the current build, produced read-only via the rocket-fuel rf-codex.sh driver and parsed deterministically by it; REVISE, wrong-phase, stale-vs-sources, crash-marker, softball-brief, and codex-outage-without-signed-risk-acceptance all block at ship. HARD at ship via ship-gate dispatch.

The refine loop exits only legitimately: scoreboard.json refine_history shows a PLATEAU (two consecutive refined-and-re-proved all-green rounds with numeric composites and no improvement; the baseline generate is refined:false so it can never be one of the pair; idle repeats never count) OR the refine_max cap in actual refine cycles is reached with residual deductions PRESENTED (or an all-green final round, which has no residuals to present). Rocket-fuel loop law, HARD at ship via ship-gate dispatch.
